outcome: Make Provider operation observable inside the system: a registry with health, limits and current assignment, so Provider state stops living only in a cost ledger outside the repository.
non_goals: Do not record a prompt or a raw provider response
Do not make the usage ledger the authority for anything other than the Loop's own execution path
Do not treat a runaway threshold as a billing budget

transitions.reason: the M5 dogfood design measured that nine of the twelve declared capabilities cannot be exercised and that five of them have no implementation at all; this task owns escalation E22-4, where there is no Provider registry, health, limit or assignment surface anywhere in the api or application layer, so provider state is observable only in the out-of-repository cost ledger and the declared capability cannot be observed

the five surface tasks were each designed to widen the same six files (the api handler, the application ports, service and read models, the openapi document, the owner console and both stores), so they cannot run at once: three concurrent writers to one file leave the coordinator resolving a textual conflict by hand, and an evidence key measured on a tree that never becomes a commit is the defect that ev-v2-013-infra-plan already recorded. They are serialised, each branching from the tip the previous one landed on
every task this one depends on is complete, so the block has cleared
Provider運用の観測面の実装に着手

GET /v1/providersでProvider運用を観測可能にした。health probeを1本も持たず、その不在をimport scanで機械的に証明した（Provider CLI invocationがちょうど0）。沈黙を健全と読み替えず観測ゼロは3 Providerすべてでunknown＋staleになる。authorizedとverified_by_loop_invocationを分離し、今日はcodexがunauthenticated・opencodeがnever-invoked-by-loop・claudeのみhealthyという実状をそのまま出す。数値しきい値をAPIに出さないことをmatcher検証済みのscanで強制した。approverが漏れないことをpositive control付きで確認した。internal/domainは0 byte変更。実装者はoutbox.goが以前からnetをimportしている実測差異に対しguardを弱めず強化した（netは名指し1ファイルのみ許可、全net.X selectorを2値に制限）
